rainbow.label: Rainbow accent
rainbow.help: Lets the accent colour cycle through the rainbow.

useBot.label: Send as bot account
useBot.help: Off: the broadcaster account sends the messages.

numberSeparator.label: Thousands separator
numberSeparator.help: Used when points are written into chat.

isChannelPointsTrigger.label: Triggered by channel points
isChannelPointsTrigger.help: On: the bet comes from the redemption, not from the chat input.

pointsVariable.label: Points variable
pointsVariable.help: The Streamer.bot user variable that holds the points.

pointsName.label: Points name
pointsName.help: How the points are called in chat messages.

defaultBet.label: Default bet
defaultBet.help: Used when a player gives no amount.

cpBetMode.label: Channel point bet
cpBetMode.help: input: the viewer types the amount. fixed: the fixed bet amount is used.

freeGame.label: Free game
freeGame.help: No points are taken or paid.

globalCooldown.label: Global cooldown
globalCooldown.help: Time before anyone can play again.

turnTimeout.label: Turn timeout
turnTimeout.help: How long a player may think before the game acts for them.

blockedGroups.label: Blocked groups
blockedGroups.help: Streamer.bot groups whose members cannot play.

addictedUsers.label: Addicted users
addictedUsers.help: These viewers win less, see the payout cut.

addictedPayoutCut.label: Addicted payout cut
addictedPayoutCut.help: How much of a win addicted viewers lose.

leaderboardResetScope.label: Reset scope
leaderboardResetScope.help: all: one board. platform: one board per platform.

overlayFolder.label: Overlay folder
overlayFolder.help: Where the overlay files are written. Empty uses the default next to Streamer.bot.

placeholders.medal: Medal emoji for the top three, else empty
